findings.title: Graph notice wiring has no page-level test
findings.problem: The graphNotice memo (graphedYaml from useWorkflowData's workflow, currentYaml and yamlHistory from the store workflow) and the WorkflowGraphNotice render are exercised by no test. getWorkflowGraphNotice.test.ts feeds the helper literal arguments and WorkflowGraphNotice.test.tsx feeds the component a literal notice. WorkflowDetailsPage.integration.test.tsx uses yaml_config_history: [] and never mentions a notice.
findings.impact: Swapping graphedYaml and currentYaml, passing the wrong history, dropping the render line or gating on the wrong workflow object would ship a details page that never shows (or always shows) the notice while every test passes. This notice is the user-facing cue for AC9 and AC11.
findings.recommendation: In src/pages/workflows/__tests__/WorkflowDetailsPage.integration.test.tsx add cases: a workflow whose yaml_config_history holds an older yaml with an execution dated before update_date shows the 'older version of this workflow' status text; an execution state whose resolved id has no node in yaml_config shows 'Steps with no node in the graph: <id>'; an execution on the current yaml shows no notice.
findings.check_notes: WorkflowDetailsPage.integration.test.tsx has a 'Graph notice' describe with older-version, missing-steps and no-notice cases rendered through the page.

fix.change: Added page-level integration tests for the graph notice wiring: older-version, missing steps, and no-notice cases

findings.title: Graph notice not gated on execution loading
findings.problem: WorkflowGraphNotice is rendered outside the !isExecutionLoading guard that wraps the editor, and graphNotice is computed from extendedStates (the previous run's states until the new ones load) against the editor config of the newly selected, possibly historical, yaml.
findings.impact: When the user switches executions, a transient false 'Steps with no node in the graph' or 'older version' notice can show until loading finishes. Reachability was not confirmed: the ordering of the store update and the editor config update was not traced.
findings.recommendation: Return null from the graphNotice memo while isExecutionLoading or isExecutionStatesLoading is true (add both to the dependency list), so the notice is computed only when execution states and the graphed yaml belong to the same run. Cover it in the page integration test.
findings.check_notes: WorkflowDetailsPage.tsx:143 returns null while isExecutionLoading or isExecutionStatesLoading; both are in the memo deps; a test holds the execution response back and asserts no notice until release.

fix.change: graphNotice memo returns null while isExecutionLoading or isExecutionStatesLoading is true; both added to its dependencies
fix.test: src/pages/workflows/__tests__/WorkflowDetailsPage.integration.test.tsx > does not show the notice while the execution is still loading
